real_world_references: lightning location networks report stroke times in UTC with a location error ellipse and a detection efficiency that falls for weak currents; nothing in the pack names a real network
electric cooperatives in the Philippines run 13.2 kV overhead distribution under the National Electrification Administration; KALVECO and its franchise are fictional
names: organisations, places, substations and people are fictional; personas drawn with guard.py names --geo Philippines at seeds 1302, 1307 and 1311
